name: Dribbling sound circuits
drawing: Sound section of the MEF00284 board schematic in the Dribbling service manual (doc 64210d7094ce, PDF p. 11) -- via MAME's netlist, compared with it and corrected
revision: Dribbling board MEF00284, sound: the TOS tone (two 74LS161s and a 74LS107 loaded from an 8255's port B), crowd noise (74LS164s, a band-pass on an LM324) with the 556 'contrasto', the whistle (556 and 74393), ball stop and save (LM339 comparators, the save through two 2N3819 JFETs), two kick oscillators (twin-T, BC239), mixed into the volume pot.
coverage: Converted from MAME's netlist and compared with the sheet, up to the volume pot VR-C's wiper; the TDA2003 amplifier after it is not in MAME, and the filter MAME puts there instead is not on the board.
